rust_summary: bulk block edits for server mods (`native_edit_blocks`).
doc_summary: `native_edit_blocks(dimension, edit)` for server mods: runs up columns, from a height or a heightmap's, of block states and filters written as commands write them, made at once straight into the chunks of the level being ticked with what `fill ... strict` does for block entities; the chunks changed go to the players whole. Bundles need `"hooks": @API:native_edit_blocks@`.
